{{Top|leg}}
The '''Finance Ministry''' was one of the Ministries under the control of the [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|Alliance Cabinet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Heading by the [[Minister of Finance (Alliance)/Legends|Minister of Finance]], the Finance Ministry was charged with raising money in order to prosecute the war against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

To achieve that goal, the Finance Ministry was empowered to levy taxes against [[Allied Command|Allied governments]]. This, however, created a strain on the government, as they would often have to pay taxes to the Empire at the same time. To raise capital, the Finance Ministry issued [[Alliance War Bond]]s, which were low-yield, long term bonds. A risky investments, they were generally bought by individuals wishing to support the war effort, not those with long-term future financial goals in mind.

The Finance Ministry also printed the [[Alliance Credit]]. While officially unrecognized as currency by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Alliance sympathizers generally took the Credit at face value, while black marketeers worked to an exchange rate of twenty-five Alliance Credits to a single [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Imperial Credit]].
